findings.label: Rules/indexes untested against live project
findings.detail: firestore.rules and the three links composite indexes in firestore.indexes.json are reasoning-verified only (no emulator, no deploy, per task constraints). Human must run emulator rules-tests and deploy/build the composite indexes before relying on this in production. Non-blocking for the local Phase-1 commit.

findings.label: No invite/code-request rate limiting
findings.detail: A stranger adult can generate decline-noise in an adult's approval desk; never activation or data exposure. Deferred to Phase 2 (needs a Cloud Function) per design §3/§10. Non-blocking.
